caption: Home
alt: ZULFAA's home screen: a greeting with the date, the next prayer and its countdown, today's challenge and quick access to every section.

caption: Prayer times
alt: The prayer times screen: the next prayer with its countdown, today's Gregorian and Hijri dates, and the five daily prayers, each with its own alert.

caption: The Noble Qur'an
alt: The Noble Qur'an: search, the surah you were reading with your progress, and the list of all 114 surahs.

caption: Reading & listening
alt: Surah Aal-i-Imran open for reading, with a card to continue where you stopped and a choice of reciters above the Arabic text.

caption: Verse options
alt: The options for a verse: play from it, repeat it, save it, add it to favourites, read its translation or tafsir, or share it.

caption: Qibla
alt: The qibla compass pointing to the Ka'bah from the chosen location, with the qibla bearing, your heading and the difference between them.

caption: Adhkar & Du'a
alt: Adhkar and Du'a: the daily wird, favourites, last read, saved and search, and du'as grouped by theme.

caption: Daily Challenge
alt: Today's challenge: five questions from ZULFAA's verified sources, in-app tokens for correct answers and a link to the Honor Board.

caption: Challenge questions
alt: A daily challenge question with four answers to choose from.

caption: Ramadan Planner
alt: The Ramadan Planner: the days until Ramadan, the estimated start date and how those dates are determined.

caption: Umrah Savings
alt: Umrah Savings before a goal is set: a button to create a savings goal and a note on how your progress is kept.

caption: Savings goal
alt: Creating an Umrah savings goal: the target amount, the currency, an optional target date and a savings plan.

caption: Notifications
alt: The notification settings: for each prayer an off, notify or adhan mode, and a reminder before the prayer.

caption: Your personal space
alt: Your personal space: an optional username, your Qur'an progress with a button to continue reading, saved items and favourites, and today's wird.

caption: Menu
alt: The side menu, with everything in one place: your personal space, the daily challenge, saved items, favourites, reading history, notifications, prayer location, settings and language.

caption: Help & Support
alt: Help & Support: frequently asked questions, a way to email the ZULFAA team and the support page on the web.
